Need superheated but geothermal and solar are not ready? The §3Gear Steam Compressor§r is the stopgap: it swallows plain steam, pays a cost, and yields theoretically less superheated — more in, less out, buying a steam grade off the books.

It is an emergency gate, not a mass-production answer: small gaps and impatient moments, flip it on; for serious superheated volume, the three wells themselves must deliver.

Structure as always: casing, pipe, gearbox and frame in one tier.

§3Superheated is nice — do not drink it like water.§r
